runs.name: LegalZoom.com, Inc.
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$6.05** (close 2026-10-12, `tools/run.py` live quote, aggregator, flagged). Shares **171,264,812** (cover of the Q2 2026 10-Q, as of 2026-07-31, acc 0001286139-26-000031; one class; 167,451 thousand issued and outstanding at 2026-06-30, repurchases retired, no treasury stock; the gap is RSU vesting); cap **$1,036.2M**. Sovereign **5.60%** (USD; US Treasury daily par yield curve, 30-year, 2026-10-09). Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (acc 0001286139-26-000012) and the FY2021 to FY2024 10-Ks, the IPO 424B4 (0001193125-21-204774), the Q2 2026 10-Q, the DEF 14A of 2026-04-22 (0001193125-26-170325), the Item 4.02 8-K and 8-K/A of February 2023, the Formation Nation 8-K and the earnings exhibits; cash $203.1M and operating cash $178.2M at 2025 cross-checked to the filed statements. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, as the overnight brief directs. Competitors: the FY2025 10-K names no rival; the four the FY2021 10-K named (BizFilings, LegalShield, MyCorporation, RocketLawyer) file no periodic reports; none compared, flagged. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: one segment (online legal formation, registered agent, compliance and subscription services for small businesses); the product is plain, the ten-year position is not: the FY2023 10-K says LZ and "some of our online competitors" began offering formations "at little or no charge" (formation order value down 25% that year); LZ's formations against the Census count fell 17% against the market's 5% in 2024, rose 4% (with the acquisition) against 9% in 2025, and fell 5% in Q2 2026; the FY2025 10-K and the Q2 2026 10-Q say AI in search has already hurt traffic and acquisition costs and that generative AI tools may be seen "as replacements"; the 8-K of 2026-08-05 cut revenue guidance for "the industry-wide shift in customer discovery away from traditional search", the chief executive declining to assume how quickly it scales. NATURE, not WORK: no unread filing answers it. Q2 to Q12 not reached; no research pass. After the stop, recorded not weighed: balance sheets 2019 to 2026-06 (the $515M pre-IPO term loan repaid from the IPO, no debt since, the $100M revolver undrawn; deferred revenue 107 to 221 every year up; goodwill doubled in 2025 on the $83.2M Formation Nation purchase); stock pay $5M to $13M a year before the 2021 IPO and $66M to $114M after ($113.7M in 2025 against $15.4M of net income), plus capitalized stock pay of $4M to $6M a year that `tools/run.py` does not deduct; buybacks of $484.5M since 2022 against $397M of stock pay, shares 198.1M to 167.5M, paid at $9.83 (Q4 2025) and $7.05 (H1 2026); the 2023 Item 4.02 restatement and the 2021-22 material weaknesses; the chief executive is also Chair, 2024 stock awards $60.7M; 38.4M awards excluded from diluted shares at mid-2026; integrity facts recorded, not judged. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after every real cost (operating cash less expensed and capitalized stock pay, less all capex) $29M, 97M, -59M, -32M, 15M, 16M, 23M for 2019 to 2025, $41M LTM; range **$1.55 a share**, a point (no-growth case alone, owner cash changing sign; 2022-25 base, a CONVENTION of the run dropping the IPO year 2021 as aberrational; serial-acquirer organic pair) against $6.05, literal 2021-25 window $0.21 beside; floor tested first: no case of the construction earns about ten percent at the price (LTM, the best base, 4.7% on enterprise value, needing 10.9% growth a year against 3.3% organic); fair price beneath the stop **$1.30 all-equity**, $0.62 equity-only; not armed (box not OUT at Q7). Contamination declared by the analyst: a filtered listing of `Test Runs/` printed the file name of another company's run (LZB, La-Z-Boy), and session-context commit subjects named KIGRY, AYI and ARCB; none opened or used. Commits 17567db3, caaced97, d5a8c2a2. Citations: the analyst's check PASS (28 ids, 17 fragments); the dispatcher's script (`fold_check.py`) 0 E-ids, every id resolved, 9 fragments matched, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) Q7 specific (a) assumes a cyclical business and gives no rule for a non-cyclical aberrational year such as an IPO year; (2) the serial-acquirer test fires trivially when owner cash is near zero or negative; (3) the all-equity basis nets cash against debt but does not say whether to strip the interest that cash earns from owner cash (removed after tax as a CONVENTION of the run); (4) neither Q4 nor `tools/run.py` names capitalized stock pay; (5) Q1's routing speaks of an industry that changes fast and does not say whether a change of channel (AI answer engines between the customer and a stable legal demand) counts; (6) no rule for Q2's field returns when no named rival files (did not arise here). The analyst could not get any rival's filing, a separable maintenance-capex figure, or a cycle for Q7's cycle rule.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): the online legal-formation and small-business compliance platform whose entry product went free across the field in 2023, whose formation share against the Census count has fallen since, and whose own filings say AI search and generative AI tools are already changing how customers find it and may replace its services; management cut 2026 guidance for the shift and declined to forecast its pace, so the ten-year position cannot be foreseen. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: a point value of $1.55 a share against $6.05, no case earning the floor; fair $1.30 all-equity ($0.62 equity-only), not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: a 2023 restatement, stock pay near $114M a year against $15M of net income, buybacks above every case computed.
